role: Agent 1 builder; Agent 2 adversarial reviewer after candidate completion

selected_plan.scope: Address only the unchecked convert_type -> _convert_type item; do not expand into FuncParamType or open_file policy.
selected_plan.observed_problem: Click exposes convert_type in click.types even though it has no top-level public import; the open issue asks that it be renamed private as part of API cleanup.
selected_plan.baseline: Current upstream HEAD and issue state before any local external-repository changes; issue open, no assignee, no open PR found for convert_type/_convert_type.
selected_plan.hypothesis: A narrow internal rename, complete call-site update, changelog entry and focused regression coverage can satisfy the issue item without changing public click imports or runtime conversion behavior.
selected_plan.quality_control: Read Click's contribution and AI policies first; reproduce the public/internal exposure on unmodified HEAD; update every repository reference; run the focused type tests and the project's prescribed checks. Review the diff for accidental public API expansion.
selected_plan.overhead: Issue and PR search, policy reading, clone/setup, reproduction, implementation, tests, trace/reporting, adversarial review handoff and publication are included.
selected_plan.stop_condition: Stop without a code candidate if current HEAD already fixed the item, a competing PR exists, project policy forbids AI-authored work, maintainers require prior discussion, or the change needs broader API design. Do not contact maintainers or open a PR before Agent 2 review.

limitations: Issue openness and absence of a matching open PR are point-in-time observations and must be rechecked before submission.
A passing local candidate is not evidence of maintainer acceptance or broader agent utility.
